commitThreshold: a bounded proximity tour visiting at least three cells
memoryRule: a proximity tour is not drawn; the witnessed cell contracts, a remote least-witnessed cell opens as a vacancy, and a third cell relays the displacement
interactionRule: pointerdown and pointermove preview a geometry-neutral proximity tour; pointerup commits a bounded tour; Enter, Space, and walk the field use deterministic tours; Delete lifts latest; Escape or R releases
representationRupture: open SVG filament organism, closed attention body, and delayed score -> eleven independent cut cells with apertures and no shared spine or enclosing contour
compositionRupture: off-axis organism, central body, and horizontal score -> broken constellation of unequal compact forms suspended in open ground
encounterRupture: draw a stroke, hold a dwell, and wait for a second beat -> circulate through at least three situated cells, then leave the field
temporalRupture: material growth, attention rewiring, and interval delay -> four accumulated proximity tours that move a vacancy through an attention ledger
mediumRupture: open stroke paths and even-odd body surgery -> independent filled SVG cut forms whose aperture, scale, rotation, and position are re-produced
renderer: deterministic inline SVG witness vacancy field
promotion: candidate / held pending local and production browser matrices, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
